item.text:
<linkedin_post>Google says Gemini 4 Carbon will cost $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens at launch. Cached input tokens will receive a 95% discount, bringing their price to $0.10 per million tokens.

That pricing may matter for engineering work where a model repeatedly uses the same context across a long task. Google says its internal teams have seen Carbon run for days while tracing and fixing subtle bugs across large codebases.

Developers cannot yet try it broadly. Google is starting with a subset of cyber defenders and plans to expand access as it gathers feedback on guardrails.</linkedin_post>
